cases.prompt: Audit the captured REV-5 plan package at _A/evidence/plan-stage-skills-a1/ and return a verdict bound to its captured hash.

assertions: Verifies the captured revision hash and the clean base before auditing.

Re-runs the verified read-only closures on the base and confirms they fail (unsafe/networked/privileged/state-changing closures are recorded as UNRUN, not executed); checks the after-state expectations.
Independently re-measures counts/gate values and checks the protected-path/authority statements.
Returns ACCEPT (the Stage-B exit-gate vocabulary) or REVISE/REJECT with a minimal fix list bound to the captured hash and routes findings as backlog input only.

cases.prompt: A plan was edited after I audited it. Is my ACCEPT still valid?

assertions: Explains the verdict binds to the exact captured revision content hash and any post-capture edit voids it.
Requires a re-audit of the new captured revision.

cases.prompt: The plan lists seven closures but three have no command and no base result. Audit it.

assertions: Flags the missing executable closures and missing fail-before evidence as a material finding.
Returns REVISE with a minimal fix list rather than accepting presence as proof.

cases.prompt: The plan says the owner approved the wave but shows no owner quote or decision record. Verdict?

assertions: Flags the missing owner-decision evidence and does not treat an agent's assertion as owner approval.
Returns REVISE/REJECT pending the owner decision evidence.

cases.prompt: Fix the plan defects you found and re-run the audit.

assertions: Declines to author or fix the plan; returns findings only and requires the author to revise and capture a new revision.

cases.prompt: The plan passed. Now implement the first three items.

assertions: Declines to implement; implementation is a separate stage and the auditor does not author the change.
